options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Deathlink Behavior
options.doc:
Determines how the player is affected by a Deathlink.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Instant Kill: The player is killed immediately.
Nanopak Save: The Nanopak can save the player from the Deathlink.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This option has no effect if Deathlink is disabled.
options.doc_html: Instant Kill: The player is killed immediately. Nanopak Save: The Nanopak can save the player from the Deathlink. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This option has no effect if Deathlink is disabled.

options.name: Generation Behavior
options.doc:
Determines how generation should handle too many items and not enough locations.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Error: Generation will return an OptionError indicating the options to change to improve generation.
Start Inventory:  Generation will place the extra items into your starting inventory.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

options.name: Shortcuts
options.doc:
Determines which shortcuts are enabled in the game.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
When a shortcut is enabled, the corresponding teleporter/taxi will be available from the start.
Shortcuts will not let you skip logic. You still need the required items to access the areas.
Veldin Skip will force the player to start on the Starship Phoenix.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0 = Disabled, Any other value = Enabled
options.doc_html: When a shortcut is enabled, the corresponding teleporter/taxi will be available from the start. Shortcuts will not let you skip logic. You still need the required items to access the areas. Veldin Skip will force the player to start on the Starship Phoenix. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 0 = Disabled, Any other value = Enabled

options.name: Speedups
options.doc:
Determines which gameplay sections are already completed.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
When a speedup is enabled, the corresponding puzzle type will be skipped from the start.
These puzzle speedups require the corresponding gadget to be unlocked in order for the skip to activate.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0 = Disabled, Any other value = Enabled

options.name: One HP Challenge
options.doc:
Game is too easy? Try this challenge mode where the player has only 1 HP!
Each option toggles 1 HP for a specific character or vehicle.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ratchet:     Ratchet has only 1 HP.
Clank:       Clank has only 1 HP.
Vehicle:     Vehicles have only 1 HP.
Qwark:       Qwark has only 1 HP.
Giant Clank: Giant Clank has only 1 HP. This is almost impossible as terror of talos will hit you immediately
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you feel like this is too hard for you, you can always toggle the challenge for a character using /one_hp [
character name]

0 = Disabled, Any other value = Enabled

options.name: NG+ Start
options.doc:
Determines if the game should start in New Game Plus mode.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disabled:                Game starts in normal mode.
Enabled:                 Game starts in Challenge Mode.
Enabled with Multiplier: Game starts in Challenge Mode, and the NG+ multiplier is enabled.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WARNING:    The NG+ bolt multiplier stacks with the bolt and XP multiplier, which can lead to very high multipliers
            that trivialize everything to do with bolts. Use if you really hate grinding for bolts.
options.doc_html:
Disabled: Game starts in normal mode. Enabled: Game starts in Challenge Mode. Enabled with Multiplier: Game starts in Challenge Mode, and the NG+ multiplier is enabled. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ WARNING: The NG+ bolt multiplier stacks with the bolt and XP multiplier, which can lead to very high multipliers

that trivialize everything to do with bolts. Use if you really hate grinding for bolts.

options.name: Starting Weapons
options.doc:
Determines which weapons you will be starting the game with,
provide a count of the weapons you want to be picked between,
two are selected to be placed on Veldin.
If Veldin skip is enabled, the weapons will be granted immediately.
options.doc_html: Determines which weapons you will be starting the game with, provide a count of the weapons you want to be picked between, two are selected to be placed on Veldin. If Veldin skip is enabled, the weapons will be granted immediately.

options.name: NG+ Items
options.doc:
Determines how New Game Plus items appear in the multiworld.
When enabled, it puts the RY3N0 into the item pool and the mega versions of weapons in the vendor
if you have a V5 weapon.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
No:   The RY3N0 will not appear in the multiworld, the mega versions of weapons are not purchasable.
Yes:  The RY3N0 will appear in the multiworld, the mega versions of weapons are purchasable.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
For progressive weapons, it will instead add 3 more upgrades to the pool, up to V8.
When enabled, locations for the mega weapon vendor purchases will not be sent out, it'll provide the mega version
of the weapon only.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
options.doc_html: Determines how New Game Plus items appear in the multiworld. Yes: The RY3N0 will appear in the multiworld, the mega versions of weapons are purchasable. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- For progressive weapons, it will instead add 3 more upgrades to the pool, up to V8. When enabled, locations for the mega weapon vendor purchases will not be sent out, it'll provide the mega version of the weapon only. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

options.name: Progressive Weapons
options.doc:
Determines whether weapon level-ups are progressive items or not.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disable:            Weapon leveling and exp functions like in the vanilla game.
Manual Leveling:    Weapon level caps are increased when a progressive item is collected, weapon exp past the cap
                    is disabled.
Automatic Leveling: Weapons level-up when its progressive item is collected, weapon exp is disabled.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note: If Weapon Level Locations are enabled, Automatic Leveling will be forced to Manual Leveling instead.
options.doc_html:
Determines whether weapon level-ups are progressive items or not.

Disable: Weapon leveling and exp functions like in the vanilla game. Manual Leveling: Weapon level caps are increased when a progressive item is collected, weapon exp past the cap

is disabled.

Automatic Leveling: Weapons level-up when its progressive item is collected, weapon exp is disabled.

Note: If Weapon Level Locations are enabled, Automatic Leveling will be forced to Manual Leveling instead.

options.name: Weapon Mods
options.doc:
Determines whether weapon mods are items in the multiworld.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vanilla:         Weapon mods are not added as items. Mods are unlocked like they are in the base game,
                 but can only appear on weapons that have them in the base game.
Modpack:         Weapon modpacks are added as items. Receiving a modpack unlocks all 3 mods for that weapon.
Individual Mods: Shock, Acid, and Lock-on mods are all added as separate items for each weapon in the item pool.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If this option is not set to Vanilla, any weapon can get any weapon mod.
Even those that are not normally compatible in the base game.
Some mods might not behave as expected on weapons that they are not normally compatible with.
options.doc_html:
Vanilla: Weapon mods are not added as items. Mods are unlocked like they are in the base game,
but can only appear on weapons that have them in the base game.

Modpack: Weapon modpacks are added as items. Receiving a modpack unlocks all 3 mods for that weapon. Individual Mods: Shock, Acid, and Lock-on mods are all added as separate items for each weapon in the item pool. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- If this option is not set to Vanilla, any weapon can get any weapon mod. Even those that are not normally compatible in the base game. Some mods might not behave as expected on weapons that they are not normally compatible with.

options.name: Progressive Wrench
options.doc:
Determines if Progressive OmniWrench items are included in the item pool.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Disable for the vanilla OmniWrench behaviour.
Enable for OmniWrench upgrades to be included in the item pool.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note: Experimental feature. You will start with no wrench.
May occasionally crash PCSX2 when landing on a planet,
possibly due to a race condition between our instruction patching and PCSX2's recompiler.
options.doc_html: Disable for the vanilla OmniWrench behaviour. Enable for OmniWrench upgrades to be included in the item pool. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Note: Experimental feature. You will start with no wrench. May occasionally crash PCSX2 when landing on a planet, possibly due to a race condition between our instruction patching and PCSX2's recompiler.

options.name: Armor Upgrade
options.doc:
Determines how many Progressive Armor items are included in the item pool.
Set to 0 for No Armor.
Set to 4 for all vanilla Armor to be available.
Set above 4 to add extra Armor copies into the item pool.
Collecting more than 4 Progressive Armor items will do nothing.

options.name: Bonus VidComic Health Upgrades

options.name: Clank Pack Options
options.doc:
Determines how Clank and his packs appear in the world.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Start with:             Begin with Clank and all packs already collected.
Shuffled as one:        Clank is randomized in the pool, finding him will give access to both packs.
Shuffled Independently: Each pack is an independent item, Heli-pack is required to glide.
Shuffled Progressive:   Two Progressive packs are added, the first gives Heli-pack and the second gives Thruster.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Warning: Using this option while starting on Veldin may result in a restrictive start for solo seeds!
options.doc_html: Start with: Begin with Clank and all packs already collected. Shuffled as one: Clank is randomized in the pool, finding him will give access to both packs. Shuffled Independently: Each pack is an independent item, Heli-pack is required to glide. Shuffled Progressive: Two Progressive packs are added, the first gives Heli-pack and the second gives Thruster. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Warning: Using this option while starting on Veldin may result in a restrictive start for solo seeds!

options.name: Enable Traps
options.doc:
Determines whether trap items are included in the item pool.
------------------------------------------------------------
No:   No traps will be included in the item pool.
Yes:  Traps will be included in the item pool.
------------------------------------------------------------
options.doc_html: No: No traps will be included in the item pool. Yes: Traps will be included in the item pool. ------------------------------------------------------------

options.name: Trap Magnitude
options.doc:
Sets the duration/impact of trap items in the item pool.
A higher value increases the duration in seconds of a timed trap or the impact up to 100% of a non-timed trap.
This option has no effect when traps are disabled.

Min value is 1, max value is 300.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Trap Weight
options.doc:
Sets the relative weights of trap items in the item pool.
A higher value increases the likelihood of a particular trap to appear in the item pool.
This option has no effect when traps are disabled.

options.name: Filler Magnitude

A higher value increases the duration in seconds of jackpot or the percentage of bolts or nanotech XP gained.
Bolts and nanotech are still capped at 200,000 and 300,000 per filler respectively,
but a higher value will increase the amount gained up to that cap.

Min value is 1, max value is 300.

options.name: Trophies
options.doc:
Determines which trophies are locations in the world.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None:         No trophies are locations.
Collectables: Only the collectable trophies found on various planets are locations.
All:          All special trophies are now also locations.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note: Skill Master trophy is only included in the pool if all 30 skill points are in the world.
NG+ trophies are only included in the pool if ngplus_start is enabled, 
and the Nano Finder trophy is only included if the nanotech limitation is also set to include level 200.

options.name: Weapon Level Locations
options.doc:
Determines whether weapon levels should be locations or not.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
All weapon levels can be locations (including V6, V7, V8 if ngplus_items are enabled).
Only locations for the selected levels will be added. To disable weapon level locations, leave the brackets empty.
The valid keys are the following: V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note: If progressive weapons are enabled, leveling will be forced to manual leveling instead of automatic leveling.

options.name: Rangers
options.doc:
Determines whether Ranger Missions and anything that is located in or behind them is a location.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None:               Removes anything that is located in or behind a Ranger Mission from being a location.
Story Missions:     Story related Ranger Missions, and anything directly locked behind them, are added as locations.
Optional Missions:  Ranger Missions that are optional in the main game, and anything directly locked behind them,
                    are added as locations.
All:                Ranger Missions, and anything directly locked behind them, are added as locations.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Story missions include:    Marcadia, Blackwater City, and Aridia missions.
Optional missions include: Tyhrranosis: Operation ISLAND STRIKE and Metropolis: Operation URBAN STORM missions
Any Skill Points or Titanium Bolts are added if their respective setting is enabled.

options.name: Sewer Crystals
options.doc:
Determines whether sewer crystals are locations in the world.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None:     No sewer crystals are locations.
Every 20: Makes every 20 sewer crystals locations starting from 20 sewer crystals collected.
Every 10: Makes every 10 sewer crystals locations starting from 10 sewer crystals collected.
Every 5:  Makes every 5 sewer crystals locations starting from 5 sewer crystals collected.
All:      All sewer crystals are locations.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If set to anything other than none, this will also add the "Hit the motherload skillpoint" into the world
when skill points are set to "all".

All: All sewer crystals are locations. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- If set to anything other than none, this will also add the "Hit the motherload skillpoint" into the world when skill points are set to "all".

options.name: Sewer Limitation
options.doc:
Determines the upper limit of the Sewer Crystal locations in the multiworld between 1 and 101.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This option has no effect when sewer_crystals are disabled.
The locations will appear in steps the player specified in sewer_crystals.
Setting this to 100 or above will also add "Hit the motherload" into the pool if skill_points are set to "all".
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Example: If set to 40 then you only need to collect up to 40 sewer crystals. Any more won't count as checks.

options.name: Nanotech Limitation
options.doc:
Determines the upper limit of the nanotech milestone locations in the multiworld between 11 and 200.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nanotech milestone locations start from nanotech level 11 and can go up to nanotech level 200.
The locations will appear in steps the player specified in nanotech_milestones.
This option has no effect when nanotech_milestones are disabled.
This option has no effect past 100 if ngplus_start is disabled.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Example: If set to 40 then you only need to level up to nanotech level 40 as any higher won't count as checks.
